title: Invertebrate (invertebrates/<id>/species.json)
description: A shrimp, a snail, a crab, a sea urchin...

role.description: What it does for the tank.

movement.description: Where it moves: on the ground, on the glass, on the decor, fixed, or swimming.

behavior.description: How it goes about on its surface. Everything here is optional: left out, the card reads what suits the `movement` of the species.

profile.description: cruiser: patrols; benthic: over the decor, with stops; hover: stays in place; sand: on the sand line, with stops. Defaults from `movement`: sand for the ground and the glass, benthic for the decor, cruiser for a swimmer.

band.description: Height in the tank it keeps to: [from, to] within 0..1 (0 surface, 1 bottom). Only read for a swimmer.

depth.description: Depth in the tank it keeps to: [from, to] within 0..1 (0 front glass, 1 back). Only read for a swimmer.

speed_cm_s.description: Pace in cm/s: [min, max]. Left out, the card takes what suits the surface (a snail on the glass is slower than a shrimp on the rock).

turn_rate.description: How fast it turns, radians per second (higher is faster).

territory_cm.description: Radius it keeps to around its home, in cm (the home is placed per inventory line in the editor, else picked at random).

burrow.description: true: lives in a burrow in the sand at its home: in it at night, mostly only its front out during the day, sometimes out around it, sometimes back in.

digs.description: true: digs its burrow (a pistol shrimp). Now and then it works at the mouth of the hole, half out, and pushes out the sand it shifts, in puffs. Needs `burrow`.

flex.description: How far the current bends it: 0 stiff (a shell, a clam), 1 very supple (the feather crown of a tube worm). Only read for a sessile species drawn from a still picture: the card makes the sway itself. Left out for one that does not bend, and for a species that walks (its clips hold its motion).

period_s.description: Time of one sway, seconds, with the current at rest: a wide crown waves slowly, a fine one quivers. Left out when it does not bend.

facing.description: Side the animal faces in the atlas (built).

length_frac.description: Share of the frame the animal fills (built).
